description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides methods for creating configuration providers based on environment variables, config files, and fallback options. It includes mechanisms for composition, caching, and unwrapping configurations, and is part of the DefaultsMode namespace.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to create and manage AWS configuration providers based on environment variables, files, or fallback defaults, supporting composition and caching.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment, config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a provider that sources configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Creates a provider that supplies fallback default configuration.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a provider based on an INI config file, optionally using a specified profile and filename.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a configuration object or promise into a ConfigurationInterface instance.
